analyzedFiles.description: All modified unit test files that were reviewed

snippet.description: The exact current code being replaced, covering the same lines/scope as `suggestedFix`, formatted as real TypeScript with line breaks (use \n between lines and preserve indentation). Must line up with `suggestedFix` so the two can be rendered as a diff (removed vs added lines) — do not paraphrase or summarize it. At most 12 lines.

explanation.description: At most 2 sentences: the leak or race, and which test observes it.

suggestedFix.description: The corrected code snippet ONLY, formatted as real TypeScript with line breaks (use \n between lines and preserve indentation). At most 20 lines. Do NOT write prose sentences here — keep all explanation in the `explanation` field.

reasoning.description: 2-3 sentences: what was investigated and why each finding was flagged or omitted
